catalogue: Australian residential and low-rise structural steel physical objects

ncc_references.relationship: Prescriptive context for the Part 6.3 structural-steel member, connection, bearing, penetration and corrosion-protection families; applicability and all numeric requirements must be checked against the clause scope.
Structural-steel framing pathway context through AS 4100.

objects.name: structural steel frame
objects.definition: A load-carrying assembly of structural-steel beams, columns, braces and connections that transfers building loads to its supports and foundations.
functions: Carry and distribute building loads
Provide the main steel load path
Coordinate members, connections, bearings and corrosion protection

cad.pattern: Scheduled linear members joined at designed nodes
cad.placement: Along the building's structural support lines
cad.opening: Only designed and coordinated penetrations

notes: This family is separate from light-gauge cold-formed residential framing even when both occur in one building.

objects.name: structural steel member
objects.definition: A fabricated steel element assigned a structural job such as beam, bearer, column or brace; its role is separate from the section profile used to make it.
functions: Carry assigned forces
Connect into the steel load path
Provide a host for connections, coatings and approved openings

cad.pattern: One scheduled member between structural nodes
cad.placement: Within a structural steel frame
cad.start: First bearing or connection work point
cad.end: Second bearing or connection work point
cad.opening: Only scheduled holes and penetrations

notes: A drawing tool should select both a member role and a section profile; neither alone fully defines the object.

objects.name: structural steel beam
objects.definition: A structural-steel member whose main job is to span between supports and carry loads applied across that span.
functions: Span between supports
Carry supported construction
Transfer reactions to columns, walls or other beams

cad.pattern: One spanning member between supports
cad.placement: Below supported framing or construction
cad.opening: Only coordinated web or flange work

notes: Beam is a role; UB is a profile family. A beam may use another suitable scheduled section.

objects.name: structural steel bearer
objects.definition: A structural-steel beam positioned beneath floor framing or another supported line so that it receives reactions from joists, walls or similar construction.
functions: Support floor framing
Collect repeated joist or wall reactions
Transfer floor loads to columns, piers or walls

cad.pattern: Bearers along scheduled support lines below floor framing
cad.placement: Below timber floor joists or supported wall lines within Part 6.3 scope
cad.opening: Member interruptions and penetrations require design

notes: Do not infer its profile from the word bearer; the Part 6.3 tables and project schedule govern within their scope.

objects.name: structural steel strutting beam
objects.definition: A structural-steel beam arranged to receive roof struts or other concentrated roof-framing reactions and carry them to suitable supports.
functions: Support roof struts
Carry concentrated roof and ceiling reactions
Transfer roof loads to supporting walls or columns

cad.pattern: One beam beneath scheduled roof-strut points
cad.placement: Below roof framing and above structural supports
cad.opening: No unapproved cuts or penetrations

objects.name: structural steel lintel
objects.definition: A structural-steel beam spanning over an opening to carry the framed construction and loads that would otherwise cross the opening.
functions: Bridge an opening
Support wall, roof, ceiling or floor framing above
Transfer reactions to supports beside the opening

cad.pattern: One member over each scheduled structural opening
cad.placement: Above an opening between designed end supports
cad.opening: Spans the opening clear width plus bearing

notes: This object is kept separate from the masonry catalogue's wall-supported steel lintel forms.

objects.name: structural steel column
objects.definition: A mainly vertical structural-steel member that carries reactions from beams or other construction down to a base connection or supporting structure.
functions: Carry vertical and assigned lateral actions
Support beams and bearers
Transfer reactions to a foundation or lower structure

cad.pattern: Columns at scheduled grid or support points
cad.placement: Below supported beams or framing
cad.opening: Only scheduled holes and attachments
cad.load: Mainly compression-member role with project-designed actions

notes: Column is a role and is not an exact synonym for the UC profile family.

objects.name: structural steel brace
objects.definition: A structural-steel member placed diagonally or otherwise arranged to restrain movement and carry assigned lateral or stabilising forces.
functions: Brace the structural frame
Carry assigned tension or compression
Transfer stabilising forces between frame nodes

cad.pattern: Diagonal or scheduled stabilising members between frame nodes
cad.placement: Within braced bays, roof planes or other designed lines
cad.opening: Must remain coordinated with doors, windows and services

objects.name: structural steel section
objects.definition: A manufactured steel length with a defined cross-sectional shape and product designation that can be assigned to a structural member role.
functions: Provide a repeatable member cross-section
Carry forces when assigned and designed as a member
Provide flanges, webs or walls for connections

cad.pattern: Constant or scheduled cross-section extruded along a member path
cad.placement: Assigned to a structural member role
cad.opening: Holes and penetrations are separate fabricated features
cad.load: Profile only; load role comes from the member assignment

notes: The profile describes shape, not whether the object is acting as a beam, column, bearer, lintel or brace.

objects.name: universal beam section
objects.definition: A hot-rolled I-shaped structural-steel section from the Australian universal beam range, normally designated by nominal depth and mass per metre.
functions: Provide flanges and a web for a structural member
Serve as a selectable profile for beams, bearers, lintels or columns where scheduled
Receive designed bolted or welded connections

cad.pattern: Standard I-shaped profile extruded along the member path
cad.placement: Where a project schedule assigns a UB
cad.opening: Holes and web penetrations are separate features
cad.load: Profile family; role is separately assigned

objects.name: universal column section
objects.definition: A hot-rolled I-shaped structural-steel section from the Australian universal column range, with proportions suited to but not limited to column use.
functions: Provide a compact flanged profile
Serve as a selectable profile for columns, beams or other scheduled roles
Receive designed connections

cad.pattern: Standard flanged profile extruded along the member path
cad.placement: Where a project schedule assigns a UC
cad.opening: Holes are separate fabricated features
cad.load: Profile family; role is separately assigned

objects.name: parallel flange channel section
objects.definition: A hot-rolled channel-shaped structural-steel section with a web and two parallel flanges projecting to one side.
functions: Provide an open channel profile
Serve as a member, edge or connection profile where scheduled
Provide a web and flanges for attachments

cad.pattern: Channel profile extruded along the member path
cad.placement: Where the project schedule assigns a PFC
cad.opening: Holes are separate fabricated features
cad.load: Profile family; role is separately assigned

objects.name: taper flange beam section
objects.definition: A hot-rolled I-shaped structural-steel beam section whose flanges taper in thickness across their width.
functions: Provide a flanged beam profile
Represent existing or specified taper-flange steelwork
Receive connections compatible with its tapered flanges

cad.pattern: Taper-flanged I profile extruded along its path
cad.placement: Where existing records or the project schedule name a TFB
cad.opening: Holes are separate features
cad.load: Profile family; role is separately assigned

notes: RSJ is ambiguous trade shorthand and is not accepted as an exact synonym.

objects.name: equal angle section
objects.definition: A hot-rolled L-shaped structural-steel section with two legs of equal nominal width.
functions: Provide an angle profile for members or connections
Form cleats, frames or bracing where scheduled
Provide two perpendicular attachment legs

cad.pattern: Equal-leg L profile extruded along its path
cad.placement: Where assigned as a member or fabricated connection part
cad.opening: Bolt holes are separate features

objects.name: unequal angle section
objects.definition: A hot-rolled L-shaped structural-steel section with legs of different nominal widths.
functions: Provide an unequal-leg angle profile
Form members or connections where different leg widths are useful
Provide perpendicular attachment faces

cad.pattern: Unequal-leg L profile extruded along its path
cad.placement: Where assigned as a member or fabricated connection part
cad.opening: Bolt holes are separate features

objects.name: welded beam section
objects.definition: A fabricated I-shaped structural-steel section made by welding separate plate flanges to a plate web and designated in the Australian welded beam range.
functions: Provide a large fabricated beam profile
Use plate components to form an I-section
Receive designed member and connection fabrication

cad.pattern: Welded I profile extruded along the member path
cad.placement: Where the project schedule assigns a WB
cad.opening: Holes and penetrations are separate fabrication features
cad.load: Profile family; role is separately assigned

objects.name: welded column section
objects.definition: A fabricated I-shaped structural-steel section made from welded plates and designated in the Australian welded column range.
functions: Provide a large fabricated flanged profile
Serve column or other scheduled roles
Receive designed member and connection fabrication

cad.pattern: Welded flanged profile extruded along the member path
cad.placement: Where the project schedule assigns a WC
cad.opening: Holes are separate fabrication features
cad.load: Profile family; role is separately assigned

objects.name: rectangular hollow section
objects.definition: A closed structural-steel tube with a rectangular outside shape and rounded corners, supplied as a designated hollow section.
functions: Provide a closed rectangular profile
Serve beams, columns, braces or other roles where scheduled
Provide flat outside faces for connections

cad.pattern: Closed rectangular profile extruded along the member path
cad.placement: Where the member schedule assigns an RHS
cad.opening: Holes and access openings are separate fabrication features
cad.load: Profile family; role is separately assigned

objects.name: square hollow section
objects.definition: A closed structural-steel tube with a square outside shape and rounded corners, supplied as a designated hollow section.
functions: Provide a closed square profile
Serve columns, braces or other roles where scheduled
Provide equal outside dimensions about both main axes

cad.pattern: Closed square profile extruded along the member path
cad.placement: Where the member schedule assigns an SHS
cad.opening: Holes and access openings are separate features
cad.load: Profile family; role is separately assigned

objects.name: circular hollow section
objects.definition: A closed structural-steel tube with a circular outside shape, supplied as a designated structural hollow section.
functions: Provide a closed circular profile
Serve columns, braces or other roles where scheduled
Provide the same outside geometry in every radial direction

cad.pattern: Closed circular profile extruded along the member path
cad.placement: Where the member schedule assigns a CHS
cad.opening: Holes and access openings are separate features
cad.load: Profile family; role is separately assigned

objects.name: structural steel plate
objects.definition: A flat hot-rolled structural-steel product cut and fabricated into connection plates, base plates, stiffeners or built-up members.
functions: Provide flat steel stock for fabricated parts
Form connection and bearing components
Form webs and flanges in built-up members

cad.pattern: One cut planar piece with fabricated edges and holes
cad.placement: Within fabricated members and connections
cad.opening: Cut-outs and holes are separate features
cad.load: Stock product until assigned a fabricated role

objects.name: structural steel flat bar
objects.definition: A hot-rolled solid rectangular steel length supplied as bar stock and used for braces, straps, cleats or fabricated connection parts where scheduled.
functions: Provide narrow rectangular steel stock
Form connection or bracing parts
Provide a simple solid profile for fabrication

cad.pattern: Solid rectangular profile extruded along its path
cad.placement: Where scheduled as a member or connection component
cad.opening: Bolt holes are separate features
cad.load: Stock profile until assigned a role

objects.name: beam tee section
objects.definition: A T-shaped structural-steel section produced by splitting a universal beam section lengthwise through its web.
functions: Provide a tee-shaped structural profile
Serve members or fabricated parts where scheduled
Provide one flange and a stem for connections

cad.pattern: T profile extruded along its path
cad.placement: Where the project schedule assigns a beam tee
cad.opening: Holes are separate features
cad.load: Profile family; role is separately assigned

objects.name: column tee section
objects.definition: A T-shaped structural-steel section produced by splitting a universal column section lengthwise through its web.
functions: Provide a compact tee-shaped profile
Serve members or fabricated connection parts where scheduled
Provide one flange and a stem

cad.pattern: T profile extruded along its path
cad.placement: Where the project schedule assigns a column tee
cad.opening: Holes are separate features
cad.load: Profile family; role is separately assigned

objects.name: structural steel connection
objects.definition: A designed assembly that transfers forces between structural-steel members or between steelwork and its support using bolts, welds, plates, cleats or anchors.
functions: Join structural parts
Transfer assigned forces
Hold connected geometry in its designed position

cad.pattern: Local assembly at a member node
cad.placement: Where two or more structural parts meet
cad.opening: Includes scheduled holes, slots and access clearances

notes: Visible contact is not enough to infer a connection; the scheduled parts and force-transfer method must be known.

objects.name: bolted structural steel connection
objects.definition: A structural-steel connection in which one or more bolt assemblies pass through aligned holes in connected parts to transfer assigned forces and retain fit-up.
functions: Join steel parts with removable fasteners
Transfer assigned forces through bolts and connected material
Support site or shop assembly

cad.pattern: One or more bolt assemblies through aligned fabricated holes
cad.placement: At a scheduled steelwork node or splice
cad.opening: Hole size, type and alignment are explicit

objects.name: welded structural steel connection
objects.definition: A structural-steel connection in which deposited weld metal fuses prepared steel parts into the designed force-transfer assembly.
functions: Join steel parts by welding
Transfer assigned forces through welds and parent material
Form shop or site connection geometry

cad.pattern: Scheduled weld runs along prepared interfaces
cad.placement: At a shop or site steelwork node
cad.opening: Access and clearances must suit the fabrication detail

objects.name: column base plate connection
objects.definition: A connection at the foot of a steel column combining the column, a base plate, welds, anchor bolts and the supporting concrete or masonry interface.
functions: Connect a column to its support
Spread column reaction into the supporting surface
Transfer assigned compression, shear, tension or moment through designed parts

cad.pattern: One base assembly at a column foot
cad.placement: Between a structural steel column and concrete or masonry support
cad.opening: Plate holes align with anchor bolts and erection tolerances

notes: The actual anchor, grout, bearing and weld details must come from the project connection design.

objects.name: structural steel member splice
objects.definition: A connection joining two lengths of a structural-steel member so they act together across a transport, fabrication or construction break.
functions: Continue a member across a break
Transfer assigned forces between member segments
Provide a practical fabrication or erection joint

cad.pattern: Local connection joining collinear or continuing member segments
cad.placement: At a scheduled fabrication or erection break
cad.opening: Includes required gap, holes and access

objects.name: structural bolt
objects.definition: A headed threaded steel fastener installed through aligned connection holes and completed with a compatible nut and any required washers.
functions: Clamp or retain connected steel plies
Transfer assigned forces in a bolted connection
Allow field or shop assembly

cad.pattern: Repeated at the designed bolt-group coordinates
cad.placement: Through aligned holes in connected steel plies
cad.opening: Occupies a matching bolt hole
cad.load: Fastener within a designed bolt group

notes: The generic object does not assume every structural bolt is a high-strength AS/NZS 1252.1 assembly.

objects.name: structural bolt nut
objects.definition: A threaded steel component fitted to a compatible structural bolt to retain and, where specified, tension the bolted assembly.
functions: Complete a bolt assembly
Provide threaded retention
Bear against a washer or connected ply

cad.pattern: One compatible nut at the threaded end of each scheduled bolt
cad.placement: Against the terminal washer or steel ply
cad.opening: Internal thread receives the bolt
cad.load: Retention part of a bolt assembly

objects.name: structural bolt washer
objects.definition: A steel ring or plate placed under a bolt head or nut where the selected bolt assembly and connection detail require a bearing surface or another specified function.
functions: Provide a bearing surface
Protect the connected face during installation
Complete the specified bolt assembly

cad.pattern: Placed concentrically with a scheduled bolt where required
cad.placement: Between bolt head or nut and connected steel
cad.opening: Central opening receives the bolt shank
cad.load: Bearing component of a bolt assembly

objects.name: structural bolt hole
objects.definition: A fabricated opening through a steel connection part that receives a bolt and includes its specified size, type and position.
functions: Provide passage and fit for a bolt
Set bolt-group geometry
Allow specified fabrication and erection tolerance

cad.pattern: Repeated at bolt-group coordinates through each connected ply
cad.placement: In connection plates, cleats and member elements
cad.opening: The object is the opening itself
cad.load: Connection geometry; not a load-carrying solid

notes: A slot is a hole type with directional geometry, not a synonym for every bolt hole.

objects.name: structural weld
objects.definition: A local run or deposit of fused weld metal joining prepared structural-steel parts according to the connection detail.
functions: Join steel parts
Transfer assigned forces
Seal or build up an interface where specifically designed

cad.pattern: Continuous or intermittent run along a scheduled interface
cad.placement: At the prepared edge or face between connected steel parts
cad.opening: Requires fabrication access around adjacent geometry
cad.load: Connector within a welded force-transfer assembly

objects.name: structural steel end plate
objects.definition: A steel plate fixed across or near the end of a member and drilled or welded to form a connection to the supporting part.
functions: Provide a member-end connection face
Carry bolt holes or welds
Transfer assigned forces into a supporting member

cad.pattern: One fabricated plate at a member end
cad.placement: Between the supported member end and supporting face
cad.opening: Contains scheduled bolt holes

objects.name: web side plate
objects.definition: A fabricated steel plate positioned beside a beam web and connected to the supported and supporting steelwork as part of a simple connection.
functions: Connect a supported member web
Carry a bolt group or welds
Transfer assigned beam-end forces

cad.pattern: One plate beside the supported member web
cad.placement: At a beam-to-support connection
cad.start: Plate top or connection work point
cad.opening: Contains scheduled bolt holes and erection clearance

notes: Fin plate usage can overlap, but the canonical name follows the cited Australian connection family.

objects.name: structural steel angle cleat
objects.definition: A short steel angle used as a connection bracket, with one leg attached to one part and the other leg attached to the connected part.
functions: Provide perpendicular connection faces
Carry bolts or welds
Transfer assigned forces between connected parts

cad.pattern: One or paired short angles at a connection
cad.placement: Between perpendicular or near-perpendicular connected faces
cad.opening: Contains scheduled bolt holes

objects.name: structural steel gusset plate
objects.definition: A shaped steel plate joining braces or several member lines at a structural node and carrying their connection bolts or welds.
functions: Collect member forces at a node
Provide connection area for braces
Carry bolt groups or welds between multiple parts

cad.pattern: One shaped plate at a brace or multi-member node
cad.placement: In the plane needed to connect member centre-lines
cad.opening: Contains bolt holes and member clearances

objects.name: structural steel column base plate
objects.definition: A fabricated steel plate fixed to the foot of a column to provide bearing and attachment to concrete, masonry or another supporting element.
functions: Spread column reaction over the support
Receive anchor bolts
Provide a weld or bearing interface for the column

cad.pattern: One plate centred or offset beneath a column
cad.placement: At the column-to-support interface
cad.opening: Contains anchor holes or slots

objects.name: structural steel column anchor bolt
objects.definition: A cast-in or post-installed threaded steel anchor connecting a column base plate to its concrete or masonry support.
functions: Locate and hold the base plate
Transfer assigned tension or shear
Stabilise the column during and after erection as designed

cad.pattern: Usually a scheduled group around a column base
cad.placement: Through base-plate holes into concrete or masonry
cad.opening: Passes through a plate hole or slot

notes: The source describes four anchors as typical, not a universal quantity; the plugin must use the project layout.

objects.name: structural steel stiffener plate
objects.definition: A local steel plate attached to a member web, flange or wall to strengthen or stabilise that region around a load, connection or slender plate element.
functions: Reinforce a local member region
Support force transfer between flanges, webs or connections
Reduce local deformation where designed

cad.pattern: One or paired local plates at scheduled load or connection regions
cad.placement: Against a member web, flange or hollow-section wall
cad.opening: May be coped around radii and weld access

notes: A stiffener should be generated only from a connection or fabrication schedule, not inferred from beam size alone.

objects.name: structural steel bearing plate
objects.definition: A steel plate placed at a support or concentrated-load interface to spread reaction over a larger bearing area.
functions: Distribute a concentrated reaction
Provide a durable bearing face
Separate a member from a supporting material where detailed

cad.pattern: One plate at each scheduled bearing point
cad.placement: Between a steel member and its support
cad.opening: May contain fixing or anchor holes

objects.name: structural steel splice plate
objects.definition: A fabricated steel cover plate spanning a member break and bolted or welded to both member segments as part of a splice.
functions: Bridge a member break
Carry splice bolts or welds
Transfer assigned forces between member segments

cad.pattern: One or more plates across a scheduled member splice
cad.placement: Over web, flange or other connected faces of both segments
cad.opening: Contains scheduled bolt holes where bolted

objects.name: structural steel bracing cleat
objects.definition: A local plate or angle connection part fixed to a frame member to receive the end of a structural steel brace.
functions: Provide a brace attachment point
Carry brace bolts or welds
Transfer bracing force into the frame node

cad.pattern: One cleat at each scheduled brace end
cad.placement: At a brace-to-beam, brace-to-column or brace-to-node connection
cad.opening: Contains scheduled bolt holes and access clearance

objects.name: structural steel member web penetration
objects.definition: A designed opening cut through the web of a structural-steel member for a coordinated service or another documented purpose.
functions: Allow a coordinated service to cross a member web
Preserve the documented opening shape and location
Provide a model host for any required reinforcement or clearance

cad.pattern: Only at individually scheduled coordinates
cad.placement: Through the web of a nominated member
cad.opening: The object is the penetration void and edge
cad.load: Opening feature; its structural effect requires design

notes: The plugin must not create a penetration merely because a service path intersects a member.

objects.name: structural steel protective paint coating system
objects.definition: A specified sequence of surface preparation and one or more paint coats applied to structural steel to provide corrosion protection for the exposure and service conditions.
functions: Protect steel from corrosion
Provide a specified finish
Identify required repair zones after fabrication or erection

cad.pattern: Continuous coating over specified steel faces with documented exclusions
cad.placement: On exposed or concealed steel surfaces according to the coating schedule
cad.opening: Continues to edges unless masked or detailed otherwise

notes: A coating system is more than a colour attribute; coat sequence and exposure classification remain explicit.

objects.name: hot-dip galvanized structural steel coating
objects.definition: A zinc coating formed by immersing fabricated steelwork in molten zinc, with coating continuity, venting, drainage and repair details tied to the fabricated object.
functions: Provide sacrificial corrosion protection
Cover fabricated steel surfaces
Protect edges and internal accessible surfaces subject to the galvanizing process

cad.pattern: Continuous zinc layer over the fabricated article subject to process openings and exclusions
cad.placement: On scheduled structural-steel articles
cad.opening: Venting and drainage holes are fabricated features, not optional graphics

notes: This is post-fabrication article galvanizing, not the metallic coating on light-gauge steel sheet.
